SELECT _retention_days AS retention_days, toUInt64(count()) AS event_rows,
 toString(min(timestamp)) AS minimum_timestamp_ns, toString(max(timestamp)) AS maximum_timestamp_ns
 FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
 WHERE attributes_string['event.id'] IN JSONExtract({event_ids:String}, 'Array(String)')
 GROUP BY retention_days ORDER BY retention_days
